body: REDGARDEN commit b2a03e3. Same merge pattern as Flamel/Druid -- Bacon (#5, withholding theme) + Puck (#67, unresolved duality theme) combined into one kit. Q self-intangibility ('ask again later'), W toggles Q's own duration, R damage+self-heal ('the trick was always the same'). ARENA_HERO_COUNT 14->15, wired into every real call site. Verified via build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, test_10_bots.sh, and a local mingw cross-compile, all clean. Closes BACKLOG S170-94.
title: 15th hero, Bacon+Puck: merged lore, real kit
